name: PrestaShop
description: PrestaShop is an open-source, self-hostable ecommerce platform (with an optional managed-hosting option) that lets merchants build a fully customizable store.
best_for: Positioned for merchants at all stages, from entrepreneurs launching a first store to established retailers scaling to millions in revenue.
features: Built-in checkout (PrestaShop Checkout) plus Stripe/Alma/Klarna integrations

alternatives.name: WooCommerce
alternatives.description: An open-source WordPress ecommerce plugin giving merchants full checkout and data ownership.
alternatives.best_for: Merchants already on WordPress wanting full control of their store.

alternatives.name: Ecwid
alternatives.description: A widget-embeddable ecommerce platform sellable on any existing site plus social channels.
alternatives.best_for: Merchants wanting to add a store to an existing website rather than rebuild it.
